_comment: 2x2x2 study sets: each joint group (shoulder, elbow, wrist) soft or rigid, same on both arms.
Name: S/E/W + r (rigid) or s (soft). Sr_Er_Wr = all rigid, Ss_Es_Ws = all soft.
Soft level = Step 0 value: Kp x0.6, Kd x0.83 (damping ratio ~2.1). Rigid = SONIC default gains.
Each gain entry: {kp: alpha} plus either {kd: beta} or {zeta: damping ratio}; beta = sqrt(alpha)*zeta/2.

Sr_Er_Wr.description: shoulder rigid, elbow rigid, wrist rigid (both arms)

Sr_Er_Ws.description: shoulder rigid, elbow rigid, wrist soft (both arms)

Sr_Es_Wr.description: shoulder rigid, elbow soft, wrist rigid (both arms)

Sr_Es_Ws.description: shoulder rigid, elbow soft, wrist soft (both arms)

Ss_Er_Wr.description: shoulder soft, elbow rigid, wrist rigid (both arms)

Ss_Er_Ws.description: shoulder soft, elbow rigid, wrist soft (both arms)

Ss_Es_Wr.description: shoulder soft, elbow soft, wrist rigid (both arms)

Ss_Es_Ws.description: shoulder soft, elbow soft, wrist soft (both arms)
